svg.text: Schematic of the town on its three hills, between the Unicorn Run and the Delimbiyr Route, from the reference images and the written sources. Not to scale.
High Moor lies south of the river
Town centre: green, pool and inns (positions assumed)
Road down to the Route (spine, assumed)
Wooden bridge over the Unicorn Run
Layout follows the three-hill town map in the reference images (hills, palisaded fort, wall, harbour, bridge over the Unicorn Run); that map is unscaled and its publication is unidentified.

Building positions, the wall circuit, the road spine and the number of piers are drawn by eye. The Tower of Amelior Amanitas, the Singing Sprite and the Seven-Stringed Harp are not plotted: no source places them.
Drawn 2026-10-15 for the Faerun Economy Engine wiki. A reconstruction, not a copy of any published map.
